title: Common definitions shared across all NMSK Atlas schemas

vec3_mm.description: 3D point/vector in millimetres, expressed in the GLOBAL anatomical reference frame unless otherwise noted. Global frame: subject in standard anatomical position (upright, palms forward), origin at the midpoint between hip joint centers, +X = subject's anatomical right, +Y = superior, +Z = anterior (right-handed).

local_frame.description: A rigid local coordinate frame attached to a bone, defined per ISB (Wu et al. 2002/2005) convention where a standard exists. Used as the parent frame for anchors, fiber fields and skinning so that attachment points move rigidly with the bone.

origin_landmark.description: Named bony landmark used as frame origin (e.g. 'glenohumeral joint center')

isb_reference.description: Citation to the ISB standardization paper, if one exists for this segment

citation.description: Author(s) Year, Title/Journal — or standard reference name (e.g. 'Gray's Anatomy 41st ed.', 'Terminologia Anatomica'). Every quantitative or topological claim in the atlas must carry one of these.

resolution_mm.description: Target linear sampling resolution for procedurally generated geometry (point clouds / surface samples) derived from this entity's parametric definition.
